name: The Pelakka wurm
description: A spectral Pelakka wurm summoned from the Arkbow that devours guards.

timeline.summary: Vivien summons a Pelakka wurm that devours guards and a spectral stag that throws a guard into a wall.
timeline.quote: The Pelakka wurm launched itself forward, all mouth and sinuous body, glowing green.
